title: Pan-Seared Pork Dumplings
description: A classic Chinese dish with a twist, pan-seared pork dumplings make for a delicious and savory meal. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine pork, soy sauce, sesame oil, green onions, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Lay dumpling wrappers on a clean surface. Place a tablespoon of pork mixture in the center of each wrapper.
Fold the dumpling wrapper by bringing the edges together to form a half-moon shape. Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the pan.
When the oil is hot, add the dumplings to the pan, leaving about 1 inch of space between each dumpling.
Cook the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
